protocol.order: alternating paired on/off order, no other validation jobs during timing
protocol.input: Known synthetic K and supplied identity correspondences; not RGB accuracy; foreground masks are explicitly ground-truth sourced
protocol.evaluation: truth stays in evaluator; one fixed seed pose/baseline gauge for each complete connected map
protocol.baseline: current rotation tracking default, pair refinement 0 and depth guard disabled
protocol.uncertainty: Depth sensitivity conditions on fixed poses/K and 1px independent coordinate noise, not total SfM confidence
